supports.excerpt:
## Evaluation
We follow the official implementation for evaluation on AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard, and MT-Bench, as follows (more details can be found under [the eval directory](https://github.com/princeton-nlp/SimPO/tree/main/eval)):

* AlpacaEval 2: Please refer to the [AlpacaEval repo](https://github.com/tatsu-lab/alpaca_eval) for evaluation.

* Arena-Hard: Please refer to to the [Arena-Hard-Auto repo](https://github.com/lm-sys/arena-hard-auto) for evaluation.

* MT-Bench: Please refer to the [FastChat repo](https://github.com/lm-sys/FastChat) for evaluation.

## Bugs or Questions?
If you have any questions related to the code or the paper, feel free to email Yu (yumeng5@virginia.edu). If you encounter any problems when using the code, or want to report a bug, feel free to open an issue! Please try to specify the problem with details so we can help you better and quicker!

skill_drafts.name: Model Evaluation on Standard Benchmarks
skill_drafts.description: Execute standardized model evaluation across AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard, and MT-Bench using official implementations. Delegates evaluation to external repositories for each benchmark's specific protocol.
skill_drafts.objective: Execute standardized model evaluation across multiple benchmarks
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Select benchmark(s)', 'detail': 'Choose from AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard, or MT-Bench based on evaluation goals'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Access official repository', 'detail': 'Refer to the official implementation repository for the selected benchmark'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Execute evaluation', 'detail': 'Follow the official evaluation protocol specific to each benchmark'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Collect results', 'detail': 'Gather evaluation scores and rankings from each benchmark run'}
{'step': 5, 'action': 'Aggregate and report', 'detail': 'Compile results for model comparison or release documentation'}
triggers: Need to assess model performance on established benchmarks
constraints: External benchmark repositories must be accessible
Official implementations must be followed for consistency
Each benchmark has its own setup and execution requirements
cautions: Each benchmark has distinct evaluation protocols; follow official implementations to ensure consistency
External repository access and dependencies required
Evaluation time and computational resources vary by benchmark
output_contract: Evaluation scores and rankings from selected benchmarks (AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard, and/or MT-Bench); comparison results ready for reporting or model selection

metadata.prompt:
To evaluate a model on standard benchmarks:
1. Identify which benchmark(s) to run: AlpacaEval 2, Arena-Hard, or MT-Bench.
2. Follow the official implementation for the selected benchmark(s).
3. Refer to the official repository for each benchmark for detailed evaluation instructions.
4. Collect evaluation scores and rankings from each benchmark.
5. Aggregate results for model comparison or release reporting.

skill_drafts.name: Issue Reporting and Support Protocol
skill_drafts.description: Structured process for reporting bugs, asking questions, and requesting support with clear escalation path and documentation requirements.
skill_drafts.objective: Ensure bug reports and support requests are properly documented and routed for resolution
applicable_signals: Error message or stack trace present
Issue not resolved by existing documentation
contraindications: General documentation questions answerable from README or official guides
Feature requests without reproducible examples or clear use case
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Verify reproducibility and check existing documentation', 'condition': 'Issue is reproducible or clearly documented; not answered in README'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Gather detailed problem specification', 'condition': 'Collect error messages, steps to reproduce, environment context, and expected vs. actual behavior'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Open issue with comprehensive details', 'condition': 'Submit issue with all gathered information to enable faster diagnosis'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Escalate via direct contact if urgent or unresolved', 'condition': 'Issue remains unresolved after reasonable time or is blocking critical work'}
triggers: Code execution error or unexpected behavior encountered
Clarification needed on implementation or usage details
Reproducible bug identified during development or testing
constraints: Problem must be reproducible or clearly specified
Details must include error context, environment, and steps to reproduce
Issue should not duplicate existing open or closed reports
cautions: Provide sufficient detail to enable maintainers to diagnose without back-and-forth
Avoid vague descriptions such as 'it does not work'
Include relevant environment information (version, dependencies, OS)
output_contract: Issue opened with detailed problem specification; support contact engaged; response received from maintainers or issue acknowledged in tracking system

metadata.prompt: When encountering code errors, unexpected behavior, or needing clarification on implementation details, follow this protocol: (1) Verify the issue is reproducible and not covered in existing documentation; (2) Gather detailed problem specification including error messages, steps to reproduce, and environment context; (3) Open an issue with comprehensive details to enable faster diagnosis; (4) If urgent or unresolved, escalate via direct contact to maintainers. Avoid using this protocol for general documentation questions, feature requests without reproducible examples, or non-technical inquiries.
